description: DeepSeek: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 via OpenRouter. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 is the October 17, 2026 snapshot of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, served by DeepSeek under the `deepseek-flash` API model name. V4.1 Flash is a sparse mixture-of-experts model
notes: Oct-17 snapshot of V4.1 Flash; most-used model on OpenRouter this week (~33T tokens/7d). Theta from AA intelligence index 39.5 (no AA coding index), mapped via anchors kimi-k3/grok-4.5. Prices are OpenRouter list prices (per-token x 1e6) from /api/v1/models on 2026-10-25; they can differ per upstream provider. Context/max output are the top provider values. Latency is estimated: OpenRouter exposes no latency/throughput stats in the public API. Non-coding skill axes derived from coding theta with fixed offsets (tweaked per model), not measured.
